notes: Every rule carries its source and effective dates. Rules with status 'active' may generate a claim; 'suggest' rules only raise a 'needs checking' finding until a second reviewer confirms the text and dates. Dates use ISO-8601. Amounts in INR.

rules.title: Failed ATM withdrawal not reversed within T+5 → ₹100/day compensation
rules.right_en: If cash was not dispensed but your account was debited, the bank must reverse it within 5 days. After that it owes you ₹100 for every day of delay — automatically, without a complaint.
rules.right_ta: ATM-ல பணம் வரல, ஆனா account-ல debit ஆயிடுச்சுன்னா, 5 நாளுக்குள்ள bank திருப்பி தரணும். அதுக்கு அப்புறம் ஒவ்வொரு நாளும் ₹100 bank உங்களுக்கு கடன்.

source.title: Harmonisation of Turn Around Time (TAT) and customer compensation for failed transactions using authorised Payment Systems

rules.formula: days_late = (reversal_date or today) - (debit_date + tat_days); compensation = max(0, days_late) * 100
evidence_required: reversal line or absence of reversal

rules.title: Failed UPI / IMPS / card-to-card transfer not reversed within T+1 → ₹100/day
rules.right_en: If a UPI or IMPS payment was debited but the beneficiary did not receive it, auto-reversal is due by T+1. After that the bank owes ₹100 per day.
rules.right_ta: UPI/IMPS-ல பணம் போயிடுச்சு ஆனா அடுத்தவங்களுக்கு வரல-ன்னா, அடுத்த நாளுக்குள்ள திரும்பணும். அப்புறம் ஒவ்வொரு நாளும் ₹100.

source.title: Harmonisation of TAT and customer compensation for failed transactions

rules.formula: days_late = (reversal_date or today) - (debit_date + 1); compensation = max(0, days_late) * 100
evidence_required: reversal line or absence of reversal

rules.title: Failed PoS / e-commerce card transaction not reversed within T+5 → ₹100/day
rules.right_en: A card payment at a shop or website that failed but was debited must be reversed within 5 days; ₹100/day after that.
rules.right_ta: கடையிலோ online-லோ card payment fail ஆயி debit ஆயிடுச்சுன்னா 5 நாளுக்குள்ள திரும்பணும்; அப்புறம் ₹100/நாள்.

source.title: Harmonisation of TAT and customer compensation for failed transactions

rules.formula: days_late = (reversal_date or today) - (debit_date + 5); compensation = max(0, days_late) * 100
evidence_required: reversal line or absence of reversal

rules.title: Minimum-balance penalty without prior notice and one-month cure period
rules.right_en: Before charging you for a low balance, the bank must tell you (SMS/email/letter) and give you one month to top up. A penalty with no warning is not allowed.
rules.right_ta: Minimum balance-க்கு charge பண்றதுக்கு முன்னாடி bank உங்களுக்கு SMS/email அனுப்பி ஒரு மாசம் time தரணும். எச்சரிக்கை இல்லாம charge பண்ண கூடாது.

source.title: Levy of penal charges on non-maintenance of minimum balances in savings bank accounts

rules.formula: penalty is claimable if no notice was received in the 30 days before the charge (user-confirmed) OR balance was above minimum throughout the prior month per statement

questions.en: Did you get an SMS, email or letter warning you about a low balance in the month before this charge?
questions.ta: இந்த charge-க்கு முன்னாடி மாசத்துல balance கம்மி-ன்னு SMS/email வந்துச்சா?

rules.title: Minimum-balance penalty must be proportionate to the shortfall
rules.right_en: The penalty must be a fixed percentage of how far you were below the minimum — not a flat fee larger than the shortfall itself.
rules.right_ta: Penalty, குறைஞ்ச தொகைக்கு ஏத்த மாதிரி இருக்கணும் — குறைவை விட பெரிய flat fee கூடாது.

source.title: Levy of penal charges on non-maintenance of minimum balances

rules.formula: flag if penalty_amount > shortfall_amount (min_balance_required - lowest_balance_in_month)

rules.title: Charges may not push the balance negative
rules.right_en: A minimum-balance charge can never take your account below zero.
rules.right_ta: Minimum balance charge-னால உங்க account minus-க்கு போக கூடாது.

source.title: Levy of penal charges on non-maintenance of minimum balances

rules.formula: flag if balance_after_charge < 0 and charge kind == MIN_BAL_PENALTY

rules.title: ATM charge within the free-transaction allowance
rules.right_en: You get 5 free transactions a month at your own bank's ATMs and 3 (metro) or 5 (non-metro) at other banks. Balance enquiries count. A charge before you cross the limit is wrong.
rules.right_ta: சொந்த bank ATM-ல மாசம் 5, வேற bank ATM-ல metro-ல 3 / மத்த ஊர்ல 5 முறை free. அதுக்குள்ள charge பண்ணா தப்பு.

source.title: Usage of ATMs / Cash Recycler Machines – Review of Interchange Fee and Customer Charges

rules.formula: for each month: count ATM txns own/other; any ATM charge levied while count <= free limit is wrongful
evidence_required: ATM transaction lines for the month

rules.title: ATM charge above the ₹23 cap
rules.right_en: Beyond the free limit a bank may charge at most ₹23 per transaction (plus tax). More than that is over the cap.
rules.right_ta: Free limit தாண்டினா ஒரு transaction-க்கு அதிகபட்சம் ₹23 (+ tax) தான். அதுக்கு மேல charge பண்ண கூடாது.

source.title: Usage of ATMs – Review of Interchange Fee and Customer Charges

rules.formula: flag ATM charge line if amount > cap * (1 + gst_rate) + 0.5

rules.title: ATM charge above the ₹21 cap (historical, until 30 Apr 2025)
rules.right_en: Between 1 Jan 2022 and 30 Apr 2025 the cap was ₹21 per transaction beyond the free limit.
rules.right_ta: 2022 Jan 1 முதல் 2025 Apr 30 வரை cap ₹21.

source.title: Usage of ATMs – Review of Interchange Fee and Customer Charges

rules.formula: flag ATM charge line if amount > cap * (1 + gst_rate) + 0.5

rules.title: SMS alert charges only on actual usage
rules.right_en: Until 31 Dec 2026 a bank may charge for SMS alerts only on an actual-usage basis, and must have disclosed the charge. A flat quarterly SMS fee with no usage basis is questionable.
rules.right_ta: SMS alert-க்கு உண்மையா அனுப்பின அளவுக்கு தான் charge பண்ணலாம்; முன்னாடியே சொல்லியிருக்கணும்.

source.title: Master Circular on Customer Service in Banks

rules.formula: flag SMS charge line for review; recoverable if no disclosure (user)

questions.en: Were you told about an SMS alert charge when you opened the account or when it started?
questions.ta: SMS charge பத்தி account open பண்ணும்போது சொன்னாங்களா?

rules.title: No charge for regulatory SMS alerts (from 1 Jan 2027)
rules.right_en: From 1 January 2027 banks may not charge for SMS alerts sent to comply with RBI rules. Any SMS alert charge after that date is not allowed.
rules.right_ta: 2027 Jan 1-ல இருந்து SMS alert-க்கு எந்த charge-ம் கூடாது.

source.circular: RBI (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Third Amendment Directions, 2026
source.title: Review of framework of limiting customer liability in digital transactions

rules.formula: any SMS charge line dated on/after 2027-01-01 is recoverable

rules.title: New or increased charges need one month's advance notice
rules.right_en: A bank must tell all depositors at least one month in advance before introducing or raising a charge.
rules.right_ta: புது charge அல்லது charge ஏத்தறதுக்கு ஒரு மாசம் முன்னாடியே சொல்லணும்.

source.title: Master Circular on Customer Service in Banks

rules.formula: flag a recurring bank charge whose amount increased vs the previous occurrence; ask whether notice was received
evidence_required: two charge lines of the same kind with different amounts

questions.en: Did the bank tell you a month before this charge went up?
questions.ta: இந்த charge ஏறறதுக்கு ஒரு மாசம் முன்னாடி bank சொல்லுச்சா?

rules.title: No minimum-balance penalty or reactivation charge on an inoperative account
rules.right_en: If your account had no customer transactions for two years it is 'inoperative'. The bank may not charge a minimum-balance penalty on it, and reactivation is free.
rules.right_ta: ரெண்டு வருஷம் நீங்க எதுவும் transaction பண்ணாத account-ல minimum balance penalty போடக்கூடாது; திரும்ப activate பண்ண காசு இல்லை.

source.title: Inoperative Accounts / Unclaimed Deposits in banks – Revised Instructions

rules.formula: if no customer-initiated transaction in the 730 days before a MIN_BAL_PENALTY or REACTIVATION charge → recoverable

rules.title: Basic Savings account: no charges, free card, conversion within 7 days
rules.right_en: Any customer can ask to convert to a Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account. The bank must do it within 7 days. It has no minimum balance and no charges for the basic services.
rules.right_ta: யார் வேணா Basic Savings account-ஆ மாத்த சொல்லலாம். 7 நாளுக்குள்ள bank பண்ணணும். Minimum balance இல்ல, charge இல்ல.

source.circular: RBI Amendment Directions on BSBD Accounts
source.title: Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account – amendments

rules.formula: if account_type == BSBDA and any MIN_BAL_PENALTY / SMS / card AMC charge → recoverable; if account_type != BSBDA and penalties recur → suggest conversion (prevent)

rules.title: Credit-card closure within 7 working days, else ₹500/day
rules.right_en: If you ask to close a credit card and have no dues, the bank must close it within 7 working days or pay you ₹500 for every day of delay.
rules.right_ta: Credit card close பண்ண சொன்னா, due இல்லைன்னா, 7 working days-க்குள்ள close பண்ணணும்; இல்லைன்னா ஒவ்வொரு நாளும் ₹500.

source.title: Master Direction – Credit Card and Debit Card – Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022

rules.formula: days_late = (closure_date or today) - (request_date + 7 working days); penalty = max(0, days_late) * 500

questions.en: On what date did you ask the bank to close the card?
questions.ta: எந்த தேதில card close பண்ண சொன்னீங்க?

rules.title: Unauthorised transaction reported within 3 working days → zero liability, shadow credit in 10 working days
rules.right_en: If money left your account without your authority and you told the bank within 3 working days, you owe nothing. The bank must credit the amount back (a 'shadow reversal') within 10 working days.
rules.right_ta: நீங்க பண்ணாத transaction-ஐ 3 working days-க்குள்ள bank-கிட்ட சொன்னா, உங்களுக்கு எந்த பொறுப்பும் இல்ல. 10 working days-க்குள்ள பணம் திரும்ப வரணும்.

source.title: Customer Protection – Limiting Liability of Customers in Unauthorised Electronic Banking Transactions

rules.formula: if user marks a debit as unauthorised and reported within 3 working days, expect a credit within 10 working days; absence → recoverable

questions.en: When did you report this transaction to the bank?

rules.title: No loan charge outside the Key Fact Statement
rules.right_en: Every charge on a loan must appear in the Key Fact Statement you were given. A charge not in the KFS may not be levied without your explicit consent.
rules.right_ta: Loan-ல எந்த charge-ம் Key Fact Statement-ல இருக்கணும். இல்லாத charge உங்க ஒப்புதல் இல்லாம போட கூடாது.

source.title: Key Facts Statement (KFS) for Loans & Advances

rules.formula: match loan charge lines against KFS charge schedule; unmatched → recoverable

document_help.name: Key Fact Statement (KFS)
document_help.fallback_en: Can't find it? Search your SMS and email for 'KFS' or 'Key Fact'. The bank must give you one on request.

rules.title: Penal charges on loans: disclosed, not capitalised, reasons communicated
rules.right_en: A penalty for a missed EMI must be a fixed 'penal charge' that is disclosed in advance, never added to the loan and charged interest on, and the bank must tell you why it was levied.
rules.right_ta: EMI தவறினா போடற penalty முன்னாடியே சொல்லியிருக்கணும், loan-ல சேர்த்து அதுக்கு வட்டி போடக்கூடாது, ஏன் போட்டோம்-னு சொல்லணும்.

source.title: Fair Lending Practice – Penal Charges in Loan Accounts

rules.formula: flag 'penal interest' lines; flag penal charge lines whose amount is not in the KFS

rules.title: Gold loan collateral returned within 7 working days of repayment, else ₹5,000/day
rules.right_en: After you repay a gold loan the lender must return your gold within 7 working days. For each day of lender-caused delay it owes you ₹5,000.
rules.right_ta: Gold loan அடைச்ச பிறகு 7 working days-க்குள்ள நகை திரும்ப தரணும். Lender தாமதத்துக்கு ஒவ்வொரு நாளும் ₹5,000.

source.title: Reserve Bank of India (Lending Against Gold and Silver Collateral) Directions, 2025

rules.formula: days_late = (release_date or today) - (repayment_date + 7 working days); compensation = max(0, days_late) * 5000

questions.en: On what date did you fully repay the gold loan?
questions.ta: எந்த தேதில gold loan முழுசா அடைச்சீங்க?

rules.title: Locker loss by negligence, fire, theft or staff fraud: up to 100× annual rent
rules.right_en: If locker contents are lost because of the bank's negligence, a fire, theft, building collapse or fraud by staff, the bank is liable for up to 100 times the annual locker rent.
rules.right_ta: Bank அலட்சியம், தீ, திருட்டு, ஊழியர் மோசடியால locker-ல பொருள் போனா, வருட வாடகையின் 100 மடங்கு வரை bank பொறுப்பு.

source.title: Safe Deposit Locker / Safe Custody Article Facility provided by the banks – Revised Instructions

rules.formula: liability_cap = annual_rent * 100

rules.title: Bank must reply within 30 days; then the RBI Ombudsman, free of cost
rules.right_en: Once you complain to the bank it has 30 days to reply. If it does not, or you are not satisfied, you may complain to the RBI Ombudsman online, free, within 90 days. Awards up to ₹30 lakh.
rules.right_ta: Bank-கிட்ட complaint பண்ணா 30 நாளுக்குள்ள பதில் தரணும். இல்லைன்னா 90 நாளுக்குள்ள RBI Ombudsman-கிட்ட free-யா complaint பண்ணலாம்.

source.title: RB-IOS 2026

rules.formula: escalation_due = complaint_sent + 30 days; ombudsman_deadline = escalation_due + 90 days

rules.title: Rejected complaints auto-escalate to the bank's Internal Ombudsman within 20 days
rules.right_en: If the bank rejects or partly rejects your complaint, its own system must send it to an Internal Ombudsman within 20 days, and the bank's final reply must reach you within 30 days.
rules.right_ta: Bank உங்க complaint-ஐ reject பண்ணா, 20 நாளுக்குள்ள அதன் Internal Ombudsman-க்கு தானா போகணும்; 30 நாளுக்குள்ள final பதில் வரணும்.

source.circular: Reserve Bank of India (Internal Ombudsman for Regulated Entities) Directions, 2026
source.title: Internal Ombudsman Directions

rules.formula: if bank reply is a rejection, note IO escalation right; final reply due complaint_sent + 30
